Hi! I\'m Gem-Legacy – Gemini for your older phone. Ask me anything, send a photo, or tap the green phone button to talk.
To start chatting, add your free Gemini API key. It only takes a minute.

Gem-Legacy talks to Google\'s Gemini with your own free API key. The key stays on this phone.

1. Tap "Get a free key" and sign in with a Google account.
2. Create an API key and copy it.
3. Paste it below, tap "Test key", then "Save".

Tip: if this phone's browser can't open the page, create the key on a computer or another phone and type it in here.
Key works! You\'re ready to chat.
Gem-Legacy tries these Gemini models in order. If one is busy or retired, it moves on to the next one. Only change this if you know what you\'re doing.

Gem-Legacy %1$s (short for Gemini Legacy) – a free Gemini chat for older Android phones (4.1 and up).

Made by DelaccTroix at FilenFolder Studio.
GitHub: github.com/FilenFolder/Gem-Legacy
Email: filenfolderofficial@gmail.com
Discord: filenfolder

Not made by or affiliated with Google. Your chat is saved only on this phone and is sent only to Google's Gemini API. Photos are never saved.

The terms of use are in the LICENSE file on GitHub.
Photos aren\'t saved, so add the photo again if you still need it.
